scope: new synthetic methods-only benchmark; no empirical data or endpoint; EOG-WF 3/31/3 unchanged

generator.algorithm: Python random.Random; for each system and world draw environment randint(0,3) for 30 states in lexicographic time/site order; iterate ordered vertex pairs in same order. If 1<=dt<=2 and rng.random()<0.40, draw barrier randint(0,2) then hard rng.random()<0.10; retain if not hard, abs(site difference)<=2*dt, abs(env difference)<=2 and barrier<=1. Waiting requires explicit edge.

estimands.local: inclusion-minimal persistent-site sets that remove a target initially reached in this world; all time copies removed; non-supporting worlds are excluded
estimands.possible_loss: inclusion-minimal site sets making a previously possible target unreachable in all originally supporting worlds
estimands.robust_loss: only for initially all-world reachable target, inclusion-minimal site sets making it unreachable in at least one world
estimands.uncuttable: if a path uses no removable site, no cut can eliminate that world under the intervention library; no vacuous cut for initially unsupported target
estimands.aggregate: compare direct subset propagation with independent path-signature hitting sets; any-world loss is Pareto-minimal union of local cuts; all-support-world loss is Pareto-minimal unions of one local cut from every supporting world; empty local cut family makes all-world loss unachievable

canonical.redundant_paths: one world: paths 00->11->23->45 and 00->12->34->45, with disjoint removable-site signatures {1,3},{2,4}; four minimal pairs, no singleton
canonical.world_difference: two worlds: 00->11->23->45 vs 00->12->34->45; third world duplicates first; any-world minimal singletons {1},{2},{3},{4}; all-world four cross pairs
canonical.uncuttable: target 40, explicit same-site path 00->20->40 in one world, another via 11; all-world impossible to cut, any-world still cuttable
canonical.unsupported: no world reaches target; no cut label

oracle: enumerate all source-to-target paths, collect removable-site signatures, independently enumerate all hitting sets and minimalize; compare per-world reachable mask for all 16 subsets, possible/robust loss frontiers, and both algebraic aggregate identities. Zero mismatches or subset monotonicity violations. Report denominators, multiplicity, uncuttable and higher-order counts; no expected positive prevalence.
stop: finite graph exact; no continuous or real conservation claims, no production API, no new empirical score, no post-score changes to generator or canonical cases.
